name: Cybele Industries Ltd
about: Cybele Industries Ltd manufactures, sells, and markets of electric wires and cables in India. The company operates in two segments, Wires and Cables, and Property Development. It offers building, flexible, communication, submersible, solar, automotive, harmonized, fire survival, UL single core, and EV charging cables for used in various fields, such as construction, railways, consumer electrical and electronics, computer, home appliances, real estate, OEM, and infrastructure, as well as industry power projects and automotive industry. The company also engages in the property development business. Cybele Industries Ltd was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Chennai, India.
